concept.title: Important
concept.shortdesc: Please note that the Test Centre workstations are equipped with either Microsoft Excel or OpenOffice

ul.li: Please note that the Test Centre workstations are equipped with either Microsoft Excel or
OpenOffice Calc. Therefore, candidates are advised to be well versed with both of these software for computation of numerical.
The sample questions and the examples discussed in the workbook are for reference purposes only. The level of difficulty may vary in the actual examination.
